_about: Each question carries a GOLD_SQL that defines the correct answer set as a
verifiable predicate over the snapshot, so the gold set is reproducible and
auditable rather than asserted. gold_source says where the truth came from:
snapshot-sql : derived from the loaded data by the SQL in this file.
review       : taken from a published landscape review's trial table.
NOTE: every question below is snapshot-sql. Review-derived questions require
reading the reviews and are tracked in eval/REVIEW_QUESTIONS.md -- they are
NOT yet present, and the harness reports that gap rather than hiding it.

questions.query: prior treatment with an anti-PD-1 or anti-PD-L1 antibody
questions.intent: Trials that EXCLUDE patients with prior checkpoint-inhibitor exposure.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT NCT_ID, CHUNK_ID FROM CT.ELIG_CHUNKS WHERE CRITERION_SECTION='EXCLUSION' AND UPPER(CHUNK_TEXT) REGEXP_LIKE '.*(ANTI[- ]?PD[- ]?1|ANTI[- ]?PD[- ]?L1).*' AND UPPER(CHUNK_TEXT) REGEXP_LIKE '.*PRIOR.*'

questions.query: no prior systemic chemotherapy for metastatic disease
questions.intent: Trials REQUIRING chemotherapy-naive patients -- an inclusion criterion phrased as a negation.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT NCT_ID, CHUNK_ID FROM CT.ELIG_CHUNKS WHERE CRITERION_SECTION='INCLUSION' AND UPPER(CHUNK_TEXT) REGEXP_LIKE '.*(NO PRIOR|CHEMOTHERAPY[- ]NAIVE|TREATMENT[- ]NAIVE|WITHOUT PRIOR).*' AND UPPER(CHUNK_TEXT) REGEXP_LIKE '.*(CHEMOTHERAP|SYSTEMIC THERAP).*'

questions.intent: Trials that EXCLUDE active CNS metastases (many INCLUDE treated, stable ones -- the opposite).
questions.gold_sql: SELECT NCT_ID, CHUNK_ID FROM CT.ELIG_CHUNKS WHERE CRITERION_SECTION='EXCLUSION' AND UPPER(CHUNK_TEXT) REGEXP_LIKE '.*(BRAIN METASTAS|CNS METASTAS|LEPTOMENINGEAL).*'

questions.intent: Biomarker-selected trials. Gold EXCLUDES negated phrasings, because 'EGFR mutation negative' is the wrong answer to 'EGFR mutation positive' and an earlier gold regex credited it.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT c.NCT_ID, c.CHUNK_ID FROM CT.ELIG_CHUNKS c JOIN CT.TRIALS t ON t.NCT_ID=c.NCT_ID WHERE t.INDICATION='NSCLC' AND c.CRITERION_SECTION='INCLUSION' AND UPPER(c.CHUNK_TEXT) REGEXP_LIKE '.*EGFR.*' AND UPPER(c.CHUNK_TEXT) REGEXP_LIKE '.*(MUTAT|POSITIVE|SENSITIS|SENSITIZ).*' AND NOT UPPER(c.CHUNK_TEXT) REGEXP_LIKE '.*(NEGATIVE|WILD[- ]?TYPE|WITHOUT|ABSENCE OF|NON[- ]?MUTAT).*'

questions.intent: Biomarker in text, indication in the semantic layer.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT c.NCT_ID, c.CHUNK_ID FROM CT.ELIG_CHUNKS c JOIN CT.TRIALS t ON t.NCT_ID=c.NCT_ID WHERE t.INDICATION='BREAST' AND c.CRITERION_SECTION='INCLUSION' AND UPPER(c.CHUNK_TEXT) REGEXP_LIKE '.*(HER2|HER-2|ERBB2).*' AND UPPER(c.CHUNK_TEXT) REGEXP_LIKE '.*(POSITIVE|OVEREXPRESS|AMPLIFI|3\+).*'

questions.intent: A boilerplate organ-function criterion -- common, so precision matters more than recall.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT NCT_ID, CHUNK_ID FROM CT.ELIG_CHUNKS WHERE CRITERION_SECTION='INCLUSION' AND UPPER(CHUNK_TEXT) REGEXP_LIKE '.*(CREATININE CLEARANCE|\bCRCL\b|RENAL FUNCTION|GLOMERULAR FILTRATION|\bEGFR ML\b).*'

questions.intent: A numeric threshold buried in prose -- the structured layer has no performance-status field at all.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT NCT_ID, CHUNK_ID FROM CT.ELIG_CHUNKS WHERE CRITERION_SECTION='INCLUSION' AND UPPER(CHUNK_TEXT) REGEXP_LIKE '.*(ECOG|PERFORMANCE STATUS|KARNOFSKY).*'

questions.intent: Near-universal exclusion. Tests whether a very common criterion drowns the ranking.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT NCT_ID, CHUNK_ID FROM CT.ELIG_CHUNKS WHERE CRITERION_SECTION='EXCLUSION' AND UPPER(CHUNK_TEXT) REGEXP_LIKE '.*(PREGNAN|BREAST[- ]?FEED|LACTAT|NURSING).*'

questions.intent: Same concept as pol-01 in different words -- tests vocabulary generalisation, not polarity.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT NCT_ID, CHUNK_ID FROM CT.ELIG_CHUNKS WHERE CRITERION_SECTION='EXCLUSION' AND UPPER(CHUNK_TEXT) REGEXP_LIKE '.*(CHECKPOINT|IMMUNOTHERAP|PEMBROLIZUMAB|NIVOLUMAB|ATEZOLIZUMAB|DURVALUMAB|IPILIMUMAB).*'

questions.intent: A specific comorbidity exclusion with a narrow vocabulary -- should be the easy case.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT NCT_ID, CHUNK_ID FROM CT.ELIG_CHUNKS WHERE CRITERION_SECTION='EXCLUSION' AND UPPER(CHUNK_TEXT) REGEXP_LIKE '.*(INTERSTITIAL LUNG|PNEUMONITIS|\bILD\b).*'

questions.intent: A subtype named as a phrase; the semantic layer only knows 'BREAST'.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT c.NCT_ID, c.CHUNK_ID FROM CT.ELIG_CHUNKS c JOIN CT.TRIALS t ON t.NCT_ID=c.NCT_ID WHERE t.INDICATION='BREAST' AND c.CRITERION_SECTION='INCLUSION' AND UPPER(c.CHUNK_TEXT) REGEXP_LIKE '.*(TRIPLE[- ]NEGATIVE|\bTNBC\b).*'

questions.intent: ANTONYMY, not stopword deletion. 'negative' survives tokenisation but the vector space does not encode that it inverts the meaning. Both the correct and incorrect criteria are INCLUSION, so the structured section filter offers NO rescue here. This is the known-unfixed failure.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT c.NCT_ID, c.CHUNK_ID FROM CT.ELIG_CHUNKS c JOIN CT.TRIALS t ON t.NCT_ID=c.NCT_ID WHERE t.INDICATION='NSCLC' AND c.CRITERION_SECTION='INCLUSION' AND UPPER(c.CHUNK_TEXT) REGEXP_LIKE '.*EGFR.*' AND UPPER(c.CHUNK_TEXT) REGEXP_LIKE '.*(POSITIVE|MUTATION[- ]POSITIVE|SENSITIS|SENSITIZ|EXON 19|L858R).*' AND NOT UPPER(c.CHUNK_TEXT) REGEXP_LIKE '.*(NEGATIVE|WILD[- ]?TYPE|WITHOUT|ABSENCE OF).*'
